item.title: Watch: Moment Duane 'Keffe D' Davis is found guilty of Tupac Shakur's murder

item.title: Norway's new king takes oath as mourners pay respects to his late father

item.title: Cup noodles made with cold water? BBC tries Japan's viral snack

item.title: Flock's rapidly expanding AI surveillance network facing growing backlash in US
